main_text.head: ASINVS AD LYRAM.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a man in a fur-trimmed cloak and tall hat, with a donkey's ears, holding a lyre-like instrument and a sprig with bells; a donkey stands at left.]

l.i: Tanto vir stolidus gestat loca celsa decore,
Excutit indignos Deus alta sede potentes,
Et dignos ima ex humilitate levat.

page.notes: The engraving occupies the centre of the page; its content is described above, not transcribed. The running head is printed in spaced capitals: EMBLEMA. The title is set in italic capitals with a decorated initial A.
